summary: Focused re-test of the ONE HIGH-priority backend bug flagged in iteration 33: admin-approved course edits were silently reverted by _ensure_course_details() (and _cache_opengolf_compact) re-fetching from OpenGolfAPI on courses that have an external_id. FIX VERIFIED — 7/7 new targeted tests PASS against a real OpenGolfAPI-sourced course, and 9/9 iter32 approve-flow regression tests still PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correctly scoped to the three write paths that could revert admin edits: admin_approve_course_edit ($addToSet manually_edited_fields with proposed change keys), _ensure_course_details (drops protected keys from the OpenGolfAPI-detail update dict), and _cache_opengolf_compact (drops protected keys from the search-cache upsert dict). No further code changes required.

manually_edited_fields is an append-only $addToSet array. If in future the admin flow gains a 'revert to upstream' action, remember to $pull the corresponding field name(s) from this array so _ensure_course_details is allowed to refresh them again.

The protected-field guard uses set() on course.get('manually_edited_fields') — safe against None/missing. Both write sites use identical semantics so behavior stays consistent whether the clobber attempt comes from GET /api/courses/{name} or /courses/search / /discover/courses / /discover/courses/nearby.
seed_data_creation: Two test edit-requests submitted+approved against a real OpenGolfAPI-sourced course (all values prefixed 'TEST' or use example.com URLs). After this run, the target course carries manually_edited_fields=['website','address'] and its website/address hold the TEST values — main agent may want to null them out or re-approve a revert if the demo course is user-facing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter33's single failing case (test_course_updated_after_approve on an OpenGolfAPI-sourced course) is now green. Both write paths that could revert an admin edit are protected (details refresh + search-cache upsert). If new endpoints are added that write to courses_col, apply the same manually_edited_fields filter. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_edit_persistence_opengolf.py can be re-run as a regression check anytime.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was _ensure_course_details() unconditionally overwriting course fields with fresh OpenGolfAPI detail values on every re-fetch (TTL expiry, empty holes, or detail_external_id mismatch triggered a refresh). Fix records the set of admin-edited field names on the course doc (courses.manually_edited_fields, populated by admin_approve_course_edit via $addToSet) and both refresh sites (_ensure_course_details for GET-time detail sync, _cache_opengolf_compact for search-cache upsert) skip those fields when building their $set. Verified end-to-end: submit edit → approve → GET x3 (with search-cache refresh in between) → all three responses keep the admin-approved website+address; re-submitting the same values now returns 400 'No changes detected' proving they persisted.
